meta.src:
schema: playbook/2
name: component_acBotOdQazx2MzaYG_playbook
title: Flow 1
actions:
  Create_Variables:
    title: Create Variables
    type: createVariables
    description: >
      Initialize variables for observable type filtering and threat intelligence record tracking
    on-success:
    - Transform_Observables: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    inputs:
    - name: Observable_Types_to_Enrich
      value:
        $:ref: $assets.AI_SOC_Threat_Intelligence_Configuration.Observable_Types_to_Enrich
    - name: Threat_Intelligence_Record_Tracking_IDs
      value: []
    inputSchemaReferenceId: be764a5c-b220-4ebf-a7ed-d95806c3d898
    outputSchemaReferenceId: 0a7d3bd0-72bd-4b58-b3c8-f0d08af35f85
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
  Transform_Observables:
    title: Transform Observables
    type: transformation
    description: >
      Filter input observables by configured types and count the filtered results
    on-success:
    - If_Observables_Count_0: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    transformations:
      filtered_observables:
        title: Filtered Observables
        description: ""
        display:
          functions: []
          advancedView: true
        inputs:
          expression: "(\n    $raw := inputs.Observables ;\n    $types := variables.Observable_Types_to_Enrich ;\n    \n    $obs := $raw[observable_type in $types] ;\n\n    $distinct([$obs]) ;\n)"
          data:
            inputs:
              Observables:
                $:ref: $inputs.Observables
            variables:
              Observable_Types_to_Enrich:
                $:ref: $variables.Observable_Types_to_Enrich
        actionType: jsonata
        next: observables_count
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
      observables_count:
        title: Observables Count
        description: ""
        display:
          functions:
          - function: count
            inputs:
            - $:ref: $actions.Transform_Observables.result.filtered_observables
          advancedView: false
        inputs:
          expression: $count(actions.Transform_Observables.result.filtered_observables)
          data:
            actions:
              Transform_Observables:
                result:
                  filtered_observables:
                    $:ref: $actions.Transform_Observables.result.filtered_observables
        actionType: jsonata
        next: ""
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
    entrypoint: filtered_observables
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
  If_Observables_Count_0:
    title: If Observables Count > 0
    type: conditional
    description: >
      Check if any observables remain after filtering to determine if processing should continue
    on-success: []
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    conditions:
    - action: ForEach_Observable
      condition:
        $:and:
        - - $:ref: $actions.Transform_Observables.result.observables_count
          - $:gt: 0
    else: ""
    inputSchemaReferenceId: 92acd3a1-754d-452e-b688-d0174376aca4
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
  ForEach_Observable:
    title: ForEach Observable
    type: loop
    description: >
      Iterate through each filtered observable in parallel for threat intelligence submission
    on-success:
    - Merge_Threat_Intelligence_Tracking_IDs: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    entrypoints:
    - Submit_Observable_to_Threat_Intelligence
    actions:
      Submit_Observable_to_Threat_Intelligence:
        title: Submit Observable to Threat Intelligence
        type: connector
        description: >
          Submit individual observable to threat intelligence component for enrichment and analysis
        on-success: []
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        action: $playbook.component_acVlX07CHqkY3nl6W_playbook
        inputs:
          Observable:
            $:ref: $loops.ForEach_Observable.value
        pool: $default
        testInputs: {}
        meta: {}
        delay: 0
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
        asset: ""
        environment: {}
    loop:
      type: for
      each:
        $:ref: $actions.Transform_Observables.result.filtered_observables
      parallel: true
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
  Merge_Threat_Intelligence_Tracking_IDs:
    title: Merge Threat Intelligence Tracking IDs
    type: transformation
    description: >
      Extract and deduplicate threat intelligence tracking IDs from all loop iterations
    on-success:
    - Update_Threat_Intelligence_Record_Tracking_IDs: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    transformations:
      Threat_Intelligence_Tracking_IDs:
        title: Threat Intelligence Tracking IDs
        inputs:
          expression: $arrayPluckBy(actions.ForEach_Observable.result,'**.Threat_Intelligence_Tracking_ID') ~> $distinct() ~> $arrayForce()
          data:
            actions:
              ForEach_Observable:
                result:
                  $:ref: $actions.ForEach_Observable.result
        next: ""
        description: ""
        display:
          functions:
          - function: arrayPluckBy
            inputs:
            - $:ref: $actions.ForEach_Observable.result
            - '**.Threat_Intelligence_Tracking_ID'
          - function: distinct
            inputs: []
          - function: arrayForce
            inputs: []
          advancedView: false
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
        actionType: jsonata
    entrypoint: Threat_Intelligence_Tracking_IDs
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
  Update_Threat_Intelligence_Record_Tracking_IDs:
    title: Update Threat Intelligence Record Tracking IDs
    type: updateVariables
    description: >
      Update variable with collected tracking IDs for component output
    on-success: []
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    inputs:
    - name: Threat_Intelligence_Record_Tracking_IDs
      operation:
        type: set
        value:
          $:ref: $actions.Merge_Threat_Intelligence_Tracking_IDs.result.Threat_Intelligence_Tracking_IDs
    inputSchemaReferenceId: 32e52fe0-14e5-452e-a7b8-5bf1a2868903
    outputSchemaReferenceId: a72744ce-d39c-4155-9647-8e289b87fd84
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
meta: {}
description: ""
namespace: $default
entrypoints:
- Create_Variables
pool: ""
timeout: 0
publish:
  Threat_Intelligence_Record_Tracking_IDs:
    $:ref: $variables.Threat_Intelligence_Record_Tracking_IDs
environment: {}
triggers: {}
inputSchemaReferenceId: 67e32afa-1c00-46f7-887e-bac2fd2c8e46
inputs:
  type: object
outputSchemaReferenceId: 8dca9fa2-4806-4c09-a7cf-12bf49c15fa6
publishSchemaReferenceId: 3f1b955a-1f8a-4b70-8a10-185f1753f2e3
